Flourish-sets are opt-in CSS-only design accents bundled per template family. Each set declares CSS rules that get injected into layout-public.ejs's <style> block when the family declares `flourish_set: <id>`. Pure CSS, no JS, no fonts, no layout shifts. All sets honor `prefers-reduced-motion` so accessibility is preserved by default.

Set selection: families opt in via `flourish_set` field in templates.json. 'none' = no flourishes (default). Sets are deliberately small + composable.

sets.name: None
sets.summary: No flourishes. Used by simple-statement and any family that wants paper-like stillness.

sets.name: Subtle
sets.summary: Quiet accents: soft hover-lift on cards, fade-in on first paint, gentle underline-on-hover for links. Default for classic-business.

sets.name: Literary
sets.summary: Editorial accents: drop-cap on first paragraph of long-text sections (via global .cas-drop-cap class), slow underline grow on links, italic-shift on hover. Pairs with editorial-statement / fraunces-inter.

sets.name: Expressive
sets.summary: Dialed-up accents: gradient-text on hero h1, glow-on-hover for CTAs, soft animated background gradient on hero section. Use sparingly. Pairs with directory-rich or event-led families that want presence.
